title: Fx0 charging with the paired lk2nd: installed r4 versus r5 with the managed policy
finding: The installed r2/r4 kernels never charge: CONFIG_CHARGER_QCOM_SMBB_POLICY is unset and the installed lk2nd publishes no handoff, so SMBB keeps HANDOFF and POLICY inhibit votes. USB only powers the system.

installed_r4_under_paired_firmware.result: handoff accepted but charging stays inhibited because r4 lacks the policy driver

r5_candidate.source: timschmidt/fx0-linux development/fx0-r5-charging-camera-01 301ccdbce1dd (r4 + three SMBB policy commits)
